title: AGENTS.md test discipline: a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file goes into that file as a top-level describe, not a new file
body:
director#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg12BtjFc5rHp7YD1J

**Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer set by ruling.** #29469 ruling 6583487846 (batch #458 item 1, Q1 letter A, maintainer 「同意」). ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` seat (`AGENTS.md` is governed text; the PR takes the maintainer's approval).

## Why

Measured on #29469 (6582607393): 69.7 % of fixes in a week opened a new test file and 78.8 % of fix test lines landed in new files. The #25911 fold took `StudioDesignSurface.*` from 95 to 86 files; a week later it was at 116, about three times what the fold saved. Without a placement rule a fold is outrun within a week.

## Change

- One line in the test discipline of `AGENTS.md`, in substance: 「a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file goes in as a top-level `describe` in that file, not as a new file」. The skills seat words it to fit the section.
- ⛔ No gate, no check script, no CI change: the ruling chose a convention agents read. The line is paid for by a deletion in the same file if `AGENTS.md` is at a line ceiling.

## Done when

The line is on `main`, and the PR body quotes ruling 6583487846.
